newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices caught again in NYMEX downdraft.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices caught again in NYMEX downdraft.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell about 1.5 cents a gallon Monday in another NYMEX downdraft, bringing its losses to over 4.5 cents since last Wednesday amid depressed values for heating oil futures.
Spot Gulf Coast 54-grade aviation-quality jet was offered at 2.65 cents below the February print, stable with Friday.
Traders said activity was slight amid celebration of Martin Luther King's birthday, a federal holiday. "It was not exactly a feverish day," one player said.
New York Harbor 54-grade also saw diffs stable at 2.10 cents below the print, traders said.
